text:
Ava (CS): quick heads-up — we're running a 45‑min microsprint for the new Subscriber cohort next Tue/Wed. need 2 hosts and 1 guest trainer. prefer EMEA‑friendly times.
Miguel: i can host but only mornings CET.
Priya: afternoon CET works for me, happy to be backup host.
Ava (CS): thanks — thinking of these slots: 
```
Tue 09:00-09:45 CET (EMEA primary)
Tue 16:00-16:45 CET (EMEA late / US overlap)
Wed 08:30-09:15 CET (shorter follow-up)
```
Sam: can do Tue 16:00 (US EST friendly), plus i can demo the rollout checklist.
Ava (CS): perfect. who can be guest trainer for Quantized Batching best practices? we want a 15m demo + q/a.
Miguel: i can do the demo if needed, will prep a 10-slide deck. :thumbsup:
Priya: if Miguel is hosting the demo, i can run the hands-on lab portion (15m) — bring a short prompt set.
Ava (CS): awesome. noting volunteers: Miguel (demo), Priya (lab), Sam (rollout checklist). need one more host to own invites and recordings.
OnboardBot: Reminder: add calendar_event with attendee list and recording enabled. Use template: onboard/sprint-microsession.
Ava (CS): @Sam can you create the calendar event & include the invite template? pls include the prework link and a one‑question feedback form.
Sam: will do, pushing invites in 10m. calendar draft: Tue 16:00 CET (convert: Tue 10:00 EDT). i put timezone note + agenda.
Ava (CS): agenda (rough): 5m intro, 15m quant batching demo, 15m hands-on lab, 10m checklist + q/a.
Priya: i added a quick prework doc to the drive and a short feedback Google Form. link in the invite.
Miguel: will attach slides and short runbook; hold for any infra blockers.
Ava (CS): thanks team — please react with :white_check_mark: once invites are sent. i'll capture post‑session feedback and surface any renewal risk signals.
Sam: invites sent. :white_check_mark:
Miguel: :white_check_mark:
Priya: :white_check_mark: 
Ava (CS): lovely. tagging CS leads to triage any attendees flagged as "needs follow-up" afterwards.
Ava (CS): (post-note) if any time conflicts pop up, i can flip Tue 16:00 <-> Tue 09:00 — shout here.
